verified: Source targets standardized by mean and standard deviation separately for each PDB, using training synthetic data
consequence: Subtracting WT removes a per-PDB mean but not its unknown energy scale. Open-minus-closed normalized outputs are descriptors, not a common-unit physical energy difference. Reference-energy invariance cannot be tested in these normalized units without target scaling.
test: Compare closed, arbitrary normalized state contrast, and independently weighted concatenated closed/open attributes on identical frozen splits
interpretation: Failure of the simple normalized contrast is not failure of absolute state-energy prediction or of the physics family; that interpretation was never established
scope: One bounded normalization/representation hypothesis; no new simulator or experimental training data
